senses.gloss: f. (בָּרָה, cmp. בְּרִית) something cut out; ring, hoop.
units: Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 7 כל הבורית טהורה בֵּרִית מחרישה טמאה ed. Zuck. (Var. בירית, בורות) every thing cut in circular form is clean (not susceptible of levitical uncleanness), except the hoop of the plough (cmp. חתיכה ibid.).—Esp. knee-band, garter.

Ib. 63ᵇ ב׳ of the Mishnah is the Biblical אצעדה. Y. ib. VI, 8ᵇ בי׳ כל שהיא וכ׳ it is called birith when single, k’balim, when the two bands are coupled with a chain. [Ar. ed. Koh. בו׳, oth. ed. בֵּרִית. Cmp. Assyr. birîtu chain, Schr. KAT 542.]
